verdicts.title: Algorithms in Real Algebraic Geometry: A Survey
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We survey both old and new developments in the theory of algorithms in real algebraic geometry -- starting from effective quantifier elimination in the first order theory of reals due to Tarski and Seidenberg, to more recent algorithms for computing topological invariants of semi-algebraic sets. We emphasize throughout the complexity aspects of these algorithms and also discuss the computational hardness of the underlying problems.
